easyPrerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
